nodes.label: Inventory application\ninterfaces
nodes.details: Catalog all inbound and outbound interfaces for Application X.

nodes.label: Map critical business reports
nodes.details: Identify reports, dashboards, and downstream consumers that depend on Application X data.

nodes.label: Assess data quality risks
nodes.details: Profile source data and document cleansing issues before migration planning.

nodes.label: Confirm compliance\nrequirements
nodes.details: Validate retention, audit, privacy, and regulatory requirements for the migration.

nodes.label: Define target access model
nodes.details: Design Application Y roles and permission groups for migrated users.

nodes.label: Prepare vendor support plan
nodes.details: Confirm vendor contacts, escalation paths, and support windows for cutover.

nodes.label: Baseline current\noperating costs
nodes.details: Capture current licensing, infrastructure, support, and operational spend for Application X.

nodes.label: Document integration ownership
nodes.details: Assign accountable owners for each integration and operational handoff.

nodes.label: Validate security review scope
nodes.details: Confirm security controls, testing scope, and approval checkpoints.

nodes.label: Create cutover\ncommunication plan
nodes.details: Draft stakeholder messaging, readiness updates, and support communications.

nodes.label: Build migration\nstaging environment
nodes.details: Provision staging resources and connectivity for migration testing.

nodes.label: Configure Application Y roles
nodes.details: Implement target roles and groups based on the approved access model.

nodes.label: Develop data\ntransformation rules
nodes.details: Create repeatable mappings from Application X data structures to Application Y.

nodes.label: Migrate historical\ntransaction data
nodes.details: Load validated historical records into Application Y staging.

nodes.label: Connect priority integrations
nodes.details: Repoint high-priority integrations and validate message flow.

nodes.label: Run user acceptance testing
nodes.details: Coordinate UAT cycles and resolve issues before production readiness.

nodes.label: Prepare operational runbooks
nodes.details: Write support procedures, recovery steps, and ownership details.

nodes.label: Execute security\nvalidation tests
nodes.details: Complete control validation and document approvals.

nodes.label: Train support and power users
nodes.details: Train support teams and departmental power users on Application Y workflows.

nodes.label: Finalize production\ncutover checklist
nodes.details: Confirm readiness criteria, rollback plan, and go/no-go checklist.

nodes.label: Switch production\nusers to Application Y
nodes.details: Move users to Application Y and monitor the first production business cycle.

nodes.label: Archive Application X records
nodes.details: Archive retained records according to compliance and business requirements.

nodes.label: Disable legacy write access
nodes.details: Lock Application X writes after production cutover to prevent split-brain updates.

nodes.label: Retire duplicate\nreporting feeds
nodes.details: Remove old reporting feeds after equivalent Application Y reports are validated.

nodes.label: Terminate unused\nvendor licenses
nodes.details: Cancel unused Application X licenses and support subscriptions.

nodes.label: Decommission legacy\nintegration jobs
nodes.details: Stop scheduled jobs and remove obsolete integration credentials.

nodes.label: Shut down Application\nX infrastructure
nodes.details: Deprovision servers, databases, storage, and monitoring resources.

nodes.label: Update disaster\nrecovery procedures
nodes.details: Update continuity plans so recovery procedures reference Application Y.

nodes.label: Close audit evidence package
nodes.details: Collect approvals, test results, and operational evidence for audit closure.

nodes.label: Publish benefits\nrealization report
nodes.details: Summarize final costs, savings, risks retired, and follow-up actions.
